member.name: T:KeshavSingh.Finance.StatementInsights
member.summary:
Reads a bank statement and works out what it says: what comes in and goes out each month, which payments recur, and which household records are therefore missing (a salary, an EMI, the rent).
Pure and deterministic — no I/O, no clock, no persistence. The consuming app decides what to do with the suggestions, and nothing is created without the user accepting it: these are heuristics over free-text bank narrations, and they are wrong often enough that silently writing records would be worse than useless.

member.summary: Amounts within this fraction of each other count as "the same payment".

member.summary: The household expense category a detected kind belongs in.
